reply_text:
Gideon, your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in this channel: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. That is the earliest message in the channel. The channel doesn't record when the kiosks actually went down, only when you reported it.

In the meantime, your 10:42 post says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM post says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch then saw. Your 11:08 AM post says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
